s: A company wants to run a custom network analysis software package to inspect traffic as traffic leaves and enters a VPC. The company has deployed the solution by using AWS Cloud Formation on three Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. All network routing has been established to direct traffic to the EC2 instances. Whenever the analysis software stops working, the Auto Scaling group replaces an instance. The network routes are not updated when the instance replacement occurs. Which combination of steps will resolve this issue? {Select THREE.)
o: Create alarms based on EC2 status check metrics that will cause the Auto Scaling group to replace the failed instance.
Update the Cloud Formation template to install the Amazon CloudWatch agent on the EC2 instances. Configure the CloudWatch agent to send process metrics for the application.
Update the Cloud Formation template to install AWS Systems Manager Agent on the EC2 instances. Configure Systems Manager Agent to send process metrics for the application.
Create an alarm for the custom metric in Amazon CloudWatch for the failure scenarios. Configure the alarm to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service {Amazon SNS) topic.

Create an AWS Lambda function that responds to the Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) message to take the instance out of service. Update the network routes to point to the replacement instance.
In the Cloud Formation template, write a condition that updates the network routes when a replacement instance is launched.

w.y: The failure is an application process dying, which EC2 status checks do not detect, and the routes are not repointed after replacement. The CloudWatch agent (procstat) publishes process metrics, a CloudWatch alarm on that metric notifies an SNS topic, and a Lambda subscriber takes the instance out of service and updates the route tables to the replacement instance.

o.A: EC2 status checks only see instance/host health, not the analysis process, and do nothing about the routes.
o.B: Correct: the CloudWatch agent's procstat plugin sends per-process metrics for the application.
o.C: SSM Agent runs Systems Manager commands; it does not publish process metrics to CloudWatch.
o.D: Correct: an alarm on the custom process metric publishes to SNS to trigger remediation.
o.E: Correct: Lambda subscribed to SNS removes the failed instance and repoints routes to the replacement.
o.F: CloudFormation conditions are evaluated at stack create/update, not when Auto Scaling launches a replacement instance.

s: Collect process metrics with the procstat plugin
Detecting and remediating process issues on EC2 instances using Amazon CloudWatch and AWS Systems Manager
